description: Core domain services and their interfaces: Extraction (OCR/PDF/text -> fields -> redaction before storage), Provenance (SHA-256, daily Merkle tree, per-notice proof, verify + tamper) with Anchor interface (LocalHashChainAnchor default, PolygonAmoyAnchor opt-in), and Comparison (candidate retrieval + ComparisonModel interface with MockComparisonModel default + HFComparisonModel opt-in + confidence gating to unresolved). Plus the provenance and comparison API routers. Corresponds to tasks.md T2, T3, T4. Depends on FEAT-001.
steps: services/extraction.py: text acquisition (pypdf for PDF bytes; pytesseract only if a tesseract binary/FINALSAY_TESSERACT_CMD is available, else raise typed OcrUnavailable; pasted text used directly). Field extractor for issuer, date, deadline, audience, action (regex/dateutil, per-field confidence). Redaction pass masking emails, phone numbers, roll/registration numbers (e.g. \b\d{2}[A-Z]{2}\d{4,}\b), and name patterns (Mr./Ms./Dr. Name, 'Name: X'). Return only redacted text + fields; never return/persist unredacted originals.

models_iface/anchor.py: Anchor ABC with anchor(root_hash)->AnchorRef; LocalHashChainAnchor appends anchor_block rows with prev_hash chaining (always available, never blocks); PolygonAmoyAnchor uses web3.py when FINALSAY_ANCHOR=polygon and creds set, wrapped in try/except that downgrades to local on any failure so ingestion never blocks.

services/provenance.py: sha256_notice(redacted_text, issuer, notice_date) canonical hash; build_daily_merkle(day) builds a binary Merkle tree (duplicate last leaf on odd count), stores merkle_root + one merkle_proof per notice (sibling path JSON + leaf_index); verify_notice(notice_id) recomputes hash + recomputes root from stored proof and compares -> {ok, tamper, details}.
api/provenance.py: endpoint to build the daily root (admin), and GET /api/provenance/verify/{notice_id} returning tamper status; support a demo tamper simulation flag.

models_iface/comparison_model.py: ComparisonModel ABC classify(premise, hypothesis)->(label, confidence, rationale). MockComparisonModel (default, deterministic): fixture-keyed predictions plus a rule engine keyed on cues (date change -> superseded/extended, 'cancel' -> cancelled, 'correction/erratum' -> corrected, date-conflict/negation -> contradictory, high overlap same facts -> consistent, else low confidence). Must classify 'exam postponed to 22 Sept' vs 'exam on 15 Sept' as contradictory or superseded (never consistent). HFComparisonModel (opt-in) uses transformers zero-shot NLI over the taxonomy labels; import transformers lazily so it is not required for the default demo.

services/comparison.py: candidate retrieval (filter official notices by institution/audience when known, rank by token overlap, top-K=5) and classify_submission that runs the configured ComparisonModel, applies confidence gating (below FINALSAY_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD -> label forced to 'unresolved' and a review_case row created), and persists a relation_edge with label, confidence, rationale, model name, status.
api/comparison.py: endpoint to run/return comparison for a submission notice id.

Tests: test_extraction.py (fields extracted; emails/phones/roll numbers masked; OcrUnavailable path handled gracefully), test_provenance.py (merkle proof verifies for all leaves; tampered content -> tamper true; local anchor chain prev_hash links), test_comparison.py (22-vs-15-Sept -> contradictory/superseded; low-confidence pair -> unresolved + review_case created; edge persisted with rationale).
acceptance_criteria: pytest test_extraction.py, test_provenance.py, test_comparison.py all pass
Default comparison model is mock and default anchor is local with no env vars set
Redaction removes emails, phone numbers, and roll numbers; only redacted text is returned
Low-confidence classification yields label 'unresolved' AND creates a review_case
Merkle proof verification detects tampered content
findings: Implemented all 7 modules + 3 test files. New files: services/extraction.py (acquire_text for PDF via pypdf / image via pytesseract only when engine present else typed OcrUnavailable / pasted text; extract_fields for issuer/date/deadline/audience/action with per-field confidence; redact() masks emails, phones, roll numbers (\b\d{2}[A-Z]{2}\d{4,}\b), Mr./Ms./Dr. names and 'Name: X'; extract() returns ONLY redacted text+fields, fields extracted from redacted text so no PII leaks). models_iface/anchor.py (Anchor ABC, LocalHashChainAnchor with prev_hash/this_hash chaining, PolygonAmoyAnchor lazy-imports web3 and try/excepts down to local, get_anchor() defaults local). services/provenance.py (sha256_notice canonical hash; build_daily_merkle duplicates last leaf on odd count, stores merkle_root+per-notice merkle_proof, anchors root; verify_notice recomputes hash+root -> {ok,tamper,details}, supports tamper=True demo flag; also detects real content mutation). models_iface/comparison_model.py (ComparisonModel ABC; MockComparisonModel deterministic rule engine + optional fixture map: cancel->cancelled, correction/erratum->corrected, conflicting dates+postpone->superseded / +extend->extended / else contradictory, negation->contradictory, high overlap->consistent, else unresolved@0.4; HFComparisonModel lazy-imports transformers zero-shot; get_comparison_model() defaults mock). services/comparison.py (retrieve_candidates filters official by institution + audience-boost, ranks by Jaccard overlap, top-K=5; classify_submission runs model, gates below FINALSAY_CONFIDENCE_THRESHOLD default 0.6 -> label 'unresolved' + creates review_case, always persists relation_edge with label/confidence/rationale/model/status auto|unresolved; no-candidate also routes to unresolved). api/provenance.py (POST /api/provenance/build admin-only; GET /api/provenance/verify/{id}?tamper=). api/comparison.py (POST /api/compare/{submission_id}). Wired both routers into main.create_app; added Merkle/Comparison Pydantic schemas. Tests: test_extraction.py (5), test_provenance.py (5), test_comparison.py (5) all green. Full suite 20 passed. Verified defaults require no env vars (mock model, local anchor) and that web3/transformers are NOT imported on the default path. NOTES: extract_fields runs on redacted text (defense-in-depth for GC-5); '22 Sept vs 15 Sept' classifies as superseded (postpone cue) never consistent; FastAPI shows included routers as _IncludedRouter mounts so a naive route.path filter won't list them - confirmed all endpoints respond via TestClient (build/verify/compare return correct 404s for missing data).
